people.name: Azel
people.line: Descendant of Saul, had six sons

people.name: Azrikam
people.line: A descendant of Saul and Jonathan.

people.name: Bocheru
people.line: Son of Azel, a descendant of King Saul

people.name: Hanan
people.line: Son of Azel, a descendant of King Saul.

people.name: Ishmael
people.line: Descendant of Benjamin through Saul's line.

translations.web: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
translations.bsb: And Azel had six sons, and these were their names: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.
translations.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
